text:
Sasha: noticed p99 spike on AMD-prod pool around 14:03 UTC, correlated with requests where seq_len > 1536. Some traces show CPU fallback.
perf-bot: [perf] p99 +420ms on pool: amd-us-west (14:00-14:10 UTC)
Sasha: example trace id tr-2026-03-16-140312
Sasha: runtime log excerpt: 
```nkernel_lookup: model=xl-8b seq=2048 -> no compatible rocm kernel found, routing=conditional_fallback -> cpu_path
```
Jay: can you paste node ROCm version and kernel registry on host?
Sasha: nodes report ROCm 5.7.1; artifact metadata shows kernels built for rocm-5.6 and rocm-5.8 only. Missing rocm_qkv_opt_v2 for 5.7.1.
Maria: I thought autotuner added a sequence-aware entry for xl-8b@2048. If the profile references kernel id that isn't present, runtime returns empty and routing jumps to CPU.
Ben: confirmed in autotuner db: profile -> kernel_id: rocm_qkv_opt_v2, but kernel-registry on those hosts lacks that id. Likely packaging pipeline skipped 5.7.* intermediate build.
Sasha: Also saw KV cache churn making batching worse: cache miss rate spiked and BatchSplitter split by seq_len, creating uneven batches.
Sasha: logs:
```nKVCache: miss_rate=0.31 average_shard=11.8MB
BatchSplitter: split_by_seq_len triggered for seq=2048 -> batches: [1xlarge, 3xsmall]
```
Maria: that + CPU fallback explains serialized token generation and huge tail latency.
Jay: short-term mitigation ideas: change conditional routing order to try alt_kernel aliases and remote rocm regions before CPU. Current order is [exact_kernel -> cpu]. Propose [exact -> alt_aliases -> remote_rocm -> cpu]. I can open a canary flag PR.
Ben: packaging fix: will push a hotfix build publishing missing qkv kernels for ROCm 5.7.1 and add CI smoke to validate kernel registry per ROCm minor.
Maria: autotuner: add a runtime guard to mark profiles 'stale' if referenced kernel_id is missing and emit WARNs to monitoring. That prevents blind routing to missing kernels.
Sasha: also propose we surface routing "reason codes" in traces (KERNEL_MISSING, BATCH_SPLIT, OOM, OVERLOADED) so we don't overreact when the root cause is batching.
Jay: agreed. Will include reason_code in routing decisions and logs. Also will add an attempt counter to routing so we try alt kernels once before falling back.
Ben: infra: can we temporarily route affected nodes to another rocm region until hotfix lands? infra: we'll tag nodes and shift routing priority for affected hosts.
Maria: will run a small benchmark on amd-canary: xl-8b seq=[1024,1536,2048] with force-alt-kernel flag to validate perf.
Sasha: action items:
- Jay: PR for routing policy change (canary feature flag)  due EOD
- Ben: hotfix build publishing missing kernels for rocm-5.7.1 + CI smoke tests  due tomorrow
- Maria: stale-profile detection + WARN/logging in autotuner  due 48h
- Infra: temporary routing priority shift for tagged nodes  asap
perf-bot: created incident INC-2026-0316-AMD-FALLBACK assigned to eng-runtime
Sasha: leaving this thread for traces and rollout notes. If you see other affected graphs ping here :eyes:
